questions.title: GARDEN CLUB - Part 1

metadata.scenario: Describe a garden or a park near your home? Write in sentences. Use 20-30 words.

questions.stem: You are a member of a garden club. You are talking to three other members in the garden club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30-40 words.

questions.prompt: I don't live in the countryside, so when I want to appreciate nature, I have to go to the park. How about you?
questions.sample_answer: I also like going to the park because I live in the city, where there is not much nature. The park helps me relax, enjoy fresh air, and feel closer to nature after busy days.

questions.prompt: I am planning to buy a house, do you think I should buy a house with a garden or without a garden?
questions.sample_answer: I think you should buy a house with a garden because it gives you space to grow plants and relax. It is also a great place for family activities and enjoying fresh air at home.

questions.prompt: People should pay a small fee to maintain public parks and gardens. What do you think?
questions.sample_answer: I agree people should pay a small fee to maintain public parks and gardens. The money can help keep them clean, safe, and beautiful, so everyone can enjoy a better environment and relaxing space.
